### Create Payout Method
POST /affiliate-manager/{locationId}/affiliate/{affiliateId}/payout-method
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/affiliate-manager/{locationId}/affiliate/{affiliateId}/payout-method
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/affiliate-manager/create-payout-method | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/affiliate-manager/create-payout-method.md

Store a payout method for an affiliate. An affiliate can hold one PayPal and one bank method; the first method stored becomes the primary one. Bank fields are validated against the requirements of the account country.

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: affiliate-manager.write
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: affiliate-manager.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id
- affiliateId* string (e.g. "63e35ac8b4dac93dfc2757c7") - Affiliate Id

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateUpdateRequest:
- paypalEmail string (e.g. "john@deo.com") - PayPal Email (required if method is PAYPAL)
- payoutMethod* string (enum: PAYPAL | BANK; e.g. "PAYPAL") - Payout method to store the details under
- bankDetails object - Bank Details (required if method is BANK)
  - bankCountry* string (maxLength: 128; e.g. "United States")
  - accountHolderName* string (maxLength: 128; e.g. "John Doe")
  - recipientAddress* object
    - country* string (maxLength: 128; e.g. "United States")
    - state string (maxLength: 128; e.g. "California")
    - city* string (maxLength: 128; e.g. "San Francisco")
    - postalCode* string (maxLength: 128; e.g. "94105")
  - fields* object[]
    - key* string (e.g. "accountNumber")
    - value* string (e.g. "12345678")

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - Payout method id
- locationId* string - Location the payout method belongs to
- affiliateId* string - Affiliate the payout method belongs to
- method* string (enum: PAYPAL | BANK) - Payout method type
- paypalEmail string - PayPal email, when the method is PAYPAL
- bankDetails object - Bank details, when the method is BANK
  - bankCountry* string - Country the account is held in
  - accountHolderName* string - Name on the account
  - recipientAddress* object - Address of the account holder
    - country* string - Country of the account holder
    - state string - State or province
    - city* string - City
    - postalCode* string - Postal code
  - fields* object[] - Bank fields required by the account country, with values reduced to their last four characters
    - key* string - Field key, as declared by the country bank mapping
    - value* string - Account-identifying values are masked to their last four characters, with the rest replaced by asterisks so the length is preserved. Descriptive fields such as the bank and branch name are returned in full.
- isPrimary* boolean - Whether payouts default to this method
- createdAt* string - Created at timestamp
- updatedAt* string - Updated at timestamp

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 403 (Forbidden): no body

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - Campaign id
- locationId* string - Location id the campaign belongs to
- name* string - Campaign name
- description string - Campaign description
- trackType string (enum: forms | surveys | calenders | funnels | websites | store | external_source | community) - What the campaign tracks
- subTrackType string (enum: lead | product | donation) - Sub track type
- liveMode* boolean - Whether the campaign is live
- currency string - Campaign currency
- payoutFrequency string (enum: PAY_7 | PAY_15 | PAY_30 | PAY_45 | PAY_60 | PAY_90) - How often affiliates are paid out
- cookieLife* number - Referral cookie lifetime in days
- commissionType string (enum: flat | percentage) - First tier commission type
- commission number - First tier commission value
- commissionTier number - Number of commission tiers
- leadCommissionTier number - Number of lead commission tiers
- isGlobalCommission boolean - Whether one commission applies to every product on the campaign
- secondTierCommissionType string (enum: flat | percentage) - Second tier commission type
- secondTierCommission number - Second tier commission value
- calculateSetupFee boolean - Whether setup fees count towards commission
- referralPermalink string - Referral link slug
- referralRealLink string - Full referral link
- domain string - Domain the referral link points at
- stepId string - Funnel or page step id being tracked
- subAfLink string - Sub affiliate signup link
- enableSubAffiliateLink boolean - Whether sub affiliate signup is enabled
- enableAutoEnrollSubAffiliate boolean - Whether sub affiliates are auto enrolled
- createdAt string - Campaign creation timestamp
- updatedAt string - Campaign update timestamp
- commissionV2 object[] - Per-tier commission configuration. This is what the commission engine applies; the flat commissionType and commission fields are the legacy fallback used only when this is empty.
  - tier* number - Tier this configuration applies to
  - defaultCommission object - Rate applied to any product without an override
    - commissionType* string (enum: flat | percentage) - Whether the commission is a percentage or a flat amount
    - commission* number - Commission value, in percent or in campaign currency
  - productBasedCommission object[] - Per-price overrides, which win over defaultCommission
    - productId* string - Product the override applies to
    - productName* string - Product name at the time the override was set
    - priceId* string - Price the override applies to
    - commissionType* string (enum: flat | percentage) - Whether the override is a percentage or a flat amount
    - commission* number - Override commission value
  - commissionLength object - How long commission keeps accruing
    - lengthType* string (enum: life-time | by-count | time-span) - Whether commission runs forever, for a number of payments, or for a period
    - length* number - Number of payments or days, per lengthType

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id

Query parameters:
- referralId* string (minLength: 3; maxLength: 64; pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,64}$; e.g. "john122") - Referral id to check, as it would appear in a referral link

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- available* boolean - Whether the referral id is free to use in this location

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 403 (Forbidden): no body
